GENERATE BURST E0p-peak-02 — the FIRE IMPACT PEAK STILL (Run C-5, experiment E0-p step 1, charter § 4; architecture 03- § 2.2b / § 2.3). task_id "E0p-peak-02". This still is the body that E0-p decomposes into pieces and brings to life at runtime — and E0(a)'s asymmetric head. Paint the SHAPE REPRESENTING EMISSION only; light, glow, flash, halo, floor light, colour and motion are runtime layers the exporter adds.

IMAGE 1 is the SCALE + REGISTER board: a 1:1 native 512×512 crop of the painted cliffside clearing at the game camera (elevated three-quarter, ~53° down) with two figures standing on the dirt — each figure is 130 px tall = 1 BH (body height) — beside a 3× nearest enlargement of the same crop for reading. Everything in the scene is hand-drawn painted 2D: a confident dark contour with taper, clean painted planes inside the line, restrained texture. IMAGE 2 is the same native crop alone (the ground the burst lands on; for reading, not for painting on).

Deliver EXACTLY ONE image, 512×512, with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background (RGBA PNG: alpha 0 everywhere outside the body, fully opaque inside it, no soft fringe wider than 1 px) — if image_gen cannot output transparency, paint it on a flat uniform #00ff00 plate instead and SAY SO in concerns. Content: the intact PEAK of a FIRE IMPACT at full extent, as ONE painted body centred on the canvas — a SYMMETRICAL BURST (Matt R-C5-109): a dense bright CORE mass at the centre-bottom, and around it a RING of flame that is CONTINUOUS — eight to ten short hooked tongues of nearly EQUAL length (no tongue more than 1.4× the shortest; none longer than 0.9× the core's own width) with FLAME FILLING THE GAPS between them (the outline reads as a scalloped, roughly circular-to-elliptical burst, never as separate arms; no octopus arms, no long reaching tendrils), the tongues curling outward and slightly upward all round, the top ones a little taller than the sides. PAINTED EXTENT: about 300 px across (2.3 BH) and about 280 px tall; nothing touches the canvas edge. FOUR flat greyscale value planes only, hard-edged, no gradients, no glow: near-black contour/rim (with taper), dark grey outer flame, light grey mid flame, WHITE core — the white core is the burst's heart and should occupy about a third of the body's area, an irregular flame-shaped mass (not a disc). Same camera as IMAGE 1 (elevated three-quarter): the base of the burst is slightly flattened as if sitting on the ground. Deliver: out/fire_peak_02.png.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "E0p-peak-02"): images = the integer count of images generated; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns listed honestly (transparency, plane count, symmetry).

references.role: IMAGE 1 — scale + register board: native 512² clearing crop with two 130-px figures (1 BH) + 3× enlargement
IMAGE 2 — the native ground crop alone (reading only)
